messages.content: Explain why salt is spread on icy roads in winter. Answer in two to four sentences of plain prose.

message.content: Salt is spread on icy roads because it dissolves in moisture and lowers the freezing point of water. This prevents water from freezing at its normal temperature, which melts existing ice and stops new ice from forming. By keeping the road surface wet instead of frozen, the salt helps vehicles maintain traction and makes winter driving much safer.
